craft_notes: Sthāyin: para-kaula formula — beyond the pair. Rows: negation then womb-cause; supreme lands last. Rejected: choosing calm over arisen — killed: neither is the doctrine (no/nanu adjudicated). Read aloud: held breath, deep landing.

lines: That steadfast, unsurpassed realm — the world both-kind and vast —
bliss, neither settled nor uprisen: womb and womb-cause of settled and risen, Kaula supreme.
l4.sanskrit_cite: taddhruvadhāmānuttaram ubhayātmakajagad udāram ānandam no śāntaṃ nāpy uditaṃ śāntoditasūtikāraṇaṃ paraṃ kaulam
